scope: Complete textual encoding grammar; decoded ASN.1 semantics excluded

requirements.decision: Parse case-sensitive BEGIN/END boundaries with exactly five hyphens and one separating space; canonical generation repeats the same label.
Validate the RFC label grammar, preserve case sensitivity, require canonical uppercase generation, and report compatible lowercase input.
Use canonical padded RFC 4648 Standard Base64 and reject noncanonical trailing bits.
Reject legacy RFC 1421 and OpenSSL encapsulated headers instead of silently treating them as body text.
Generate exact 64-character non-final lines with no extraneous whitespace and require one nonempty 4-to-64-character final quantum line; strict parsing enforces the same Figure 3 shape.
The explicitly named compatible policy handles CRLF, CR, and LF and bounded ignored body bytes while returning deviation metadata.
Parse multiple ordered instances amid explicitly bounded explanatory, interstitial, and trailing text.
Ordinary parsing never claims ASN.1 type validation; secret release requires one exact caller-expected label to prevent silent type confusion.
